title: OL-20261112-14: external dependencies X-1 and X-3
body:

**Trigger:** every executor run

**Status:** closed
**Residual:** ext-deps-x1-x3

Track the external dependency items X-1 and X-3; replace the probe with the items' own closing probes when read from the dependency-unification record.
